basics.name: Gangshan Jing
basics.label: Professor in Network Systems Control
basics.summary: A researcher with strong passion for network systems

work.name: School of Automation, Chongqing University
work.position: Professor of Control Science and Engineering
work.summary: Professor in Control Science and Engineering at Chongqing University, specializing in network systems control.
highlights: angle rigid formation control and network localization; graph-based MARL, graph-based multi-finger manipulation

work.name: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, North Carolina State University
work.summary: Working on scalable MARL under supervision of Prof. Aranya Chakrabortty, collaborating with Dr. He Bai at Oklahoma State University and Dr. Jemin George at US Army Research Laboratory.
highlights: hiearchical MARL, model-free LQR, zero-order optimization

work.name: Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Ohio State University
work.summary: Working on decomposable large-scale optimization problems with applications to aircraft motion planning and network localization, under supervision of Prof. Ran Dai.
highlights: numerical nonconvex Optimization, QCQP, ADMM, Mars landing

work.name: Department of Applied Mathematics, HongKong Polytechnic University
work.summary: Working on weak rigidity theory and angle rigidity theory as well as their applications to formation control, under supervision of Prof. Guofeng Zhang.
highlights: weak rigidity, angle rigidity, formation stabilization
